fields.label: Enable calculator
fields.name: enable_calculator
fields.instructions: Enable this to show calculator on product page. Important: calculator heavily relies on product dimensions (Product data > Shipping > Dimensions) to work properly. Make sure to fill them in. 4mm to the board width will be added automatically. So, if width = 176mm, calculator will use 180mm as the width of the board.

fields.label: Boards per sqm
fields.name: boards_per_sqm
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty to use default calculation. By default, calculator will use dimensions of the product to calculate the area.

fields.label: Hide product pricing description
fields.name: hide_pricing_description
fields.instructions: Enable this to hide the product pricing description.

fields.label: Product pricing description override
fields.name: pricing_description_override
fields.instructions: Provide a description for the product pricing.
